runbook_yaml:
runbook: rb-001
title: "Quarantine the retrieval index (policy-index)"
reads: [index.stale_docs_pct, index.fallback_health, change.freeze]
params:
  target: policy-index
  channel: ai-incident
steps:
  - id: s1
    title: "Confirm the metric is over the line"
    effect: read
    risk: low
    run: "ragctl status --target {{target}}"
    requires: ["index.stale_docs_pct >= 10"]
  - id: s2
    title: "Confirm the fallback is healthy"
    effect: read
    risk: low
    run: "ragctl health --target {{target}} --fallback"
    requires: ["index.fallback_health == healthy"]
  - id: s3
    title: "Quarantine the retrieval index"
    effect: write
    risk: high
    run: "ragctl quarantine --index {{target}}"
    requires: ["change.freeze == off"]
    sets: {index.mode: quarantined}
    approval:
      role: incident-commander
      ttl_minutes: 30
    rollback: "ragctl release --index {{target}}"
  - id: s4
    title: "Tell the incident channel"
    effect: notify
    risk: low
    run: "chatctl post --channel {{channel}} --text 'mitigation applied to {{target}}'"
  - id: s5
    title: "Verify the change"
    effect: read
    risk: low
    run: "ragctl status --target {{target}}"
    requires: ["index.mode == quarantined"]

runbook: rb-002
title: "Roll the model back to the previous version (scorer-v7)"
